description: Smooth high-resolution hand-painted unit art. Static artwork only. Deterministic normalization and layer masks preserve the renderer virtual coordinates; animation is performed by the game runtime.

prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: ONE final standalone STATIC high-resolution 2D game character on transparent background, not animation. Reference1 is the CURRENT approved smooth illustrated sprout-bean and is the authority for every feature except the body shape. Reference2 is the ORIGINAL creature, only a body-shape / personality reference, never a pixel-rendering reference. Make a focused shape correction to reference1: REMOVE the pointed teardrop / pear-shaped upper body. Replace the seed body's outline with a near-CIRCULAR soft bean or very slightly broad round oval, whose maximum width occurs near the vertical MIDDLE of the body. WIDEN the upper shoulders and join them into the crown with one broad gentle smooth circular arc. No narrow raised crown, no triangular upper head, no pointed apex under the sprout, no egg taper, no pear/gourd shape. The upper half should look like a softly rounded little ball, with full shoulders already about85-90% of body width at one quarter of its height. Main body width approximately equal to height or at most5% wider. A subtly flat relaxed bottom is okay. Do NOT make a flat squat pancake. Keep reference1's EXACT two small nearly circular very dark green eyes with one small muted sage glint each, restrained matte pale light yellow-green color, gentle2-3 broad smooth shading regions and thin continuous deep-teal outlines. Keep the same calm innocent face, eye spacing and modest eye size, no big white highlights or elongated glass eyes. Preserve its short small pale-green root feet, no shiny pebble material. Preserve exactly2 simple broad green seed leaves in a V shape, short straight green stem, no extra curls/ornaments or decorative veins. Front-facing symmetrical neutral pose. No mouth, nose, blush, arms, equipment, ground or shadow. Smooth antialiased high-resolution hand-painted 2D fantasy illustration; avoid ceramic, plastic, glossy3D toy, photorealism. Absolutely NO pixel art, stair-step contours, dithering, coarse blocks, mosaic, low resolution or nearest-neighbor effect. Full character entirely visible with slight transparent padding. No text, labels, border, extra characters or props.

Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one final high-resolution STATIC layered 2D game equipment part, not a character, not an animation or sprite sheet. Reference 1 is the exact existing equipment part to redraw. Reference 2 is the approved flower-nest art style. Redraw the equipment in the same front-facing neutral angle, same arrangement and relative proportions as reference 1. Only the detached equipment and transparent negative space, NO creature or body behind it. Smooth hand-painted fantasy illustration matching reference2: finely resolved continuous deep-teal outline, softly blended highlights and shaded rounded forms, clean antialiased silhouette, tasteful cream/sage bounced light. User strongly dislikes pixel art: absolutely NO pixels, stair-step contours, mosaic, dithering, coarse blocks, nearest-neighbor texture, rigid color bands. No text, labels, shadows cast onto a background, ground or frame. Preserve full shape in canvas with a little transparent padding. Large crisp high-resolution artwork. Subject: two modest muscular green plant arms, one on each side, holding a single wide shallow green leaf bowl between their hands at the front. Exactly one small upward-curled leaf biceps per arm. The bowl middle top edge at about half artwork height; arms surround it. Bowl interior is visible, rear rim smooth, center is transparent above bowl.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Production asset: ONE final STATIC transparent game equipment sprite, a botanical DISH-SHAPED SENSORY ANTENNA for a cute sprout-bean creature. Reference image 1 is the ORIGINAL DESIGN AUTHORITY: preserve the ONE shallow concave oval leaf dish at the very top of the creature, with a pale ivory-green thick rim, soft sage-green inner bowl and exactly one small green round receiver on a tiny upright peg in the middle of the bowl. Reference image 2 defines the CURRENT APPROVED SMOOTH HIGH-RESOLUTION ART STYLE and material, not the anatomy. Render ONLY the isolated complete dish-and-stem equipment, no creature, no body, no eyes, no face, no sprout leaves. This is the sense level 1 accessory. A single simple short straight green stem rooted at bottom center supports exactly ONE dish, centered above it, open upward and slightly toward the viewer, same gently elevated front view as the original sprite. The dish should read immediately as the original leaf satellite receiver, a calm broad oval cup about 1.5 times wider than the whole part is tall. Keep the little receiver nub INSIDE the cup, not on a separate tall stalk. Preserve the plant anatomy and simple cute proportions; do not invent insect antennae, curved tendrils, purple orbs, paired stalks, flowers, extra leaves, metal, wires, technology panels or lights. Match reference 2's pale yellow-green and sage palette, thin continuous dark teal-green outline, smoothly blended matte hand-painted volume and softly rounded edges. Absolutely NO pixel art, jagged edges, dithering, blocky clusters, glossy plastic or photorealism. The short stem must end in a fully finished rounded root at bottom center, ready to attach to the creature. One single complete object filling a landscape canvas with generous transparent margins. TRUE RGBA transparency, no painted checkerboard, no background, no ground or cast shadow, no text, no border. This actual image will be directly used as a runtime layered sprite.
prompts.cleanupPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a production transparency cleanup of the reference dish-shaped green plant sensor. Preserve its exact single oval dish, pale ivory-green rim, sage concave bowl, small central green receiver nub on its short peg, short lower green root stem, smooth high-resolution hand-painted shading, proportions and dark teal outlines. REMOVE ALL exterior green glow, haze, mist, blur, light aura and shadow outside the dark outline. The outside boundary must be crisply antialiased and immediately fully transparent. No translucent cloud around the dish, no illumination spilling beyond its silhouette, no shadow under it, no vignette. Interior bowl shading stays exactly as drawn. One whole isolated object with genuine clean alpha transparency, generous clear outer padding. No new details or anatomy, no text, no checkerboard. This will be layered directly on a game character.

prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production asset: ONE final STATIC transparent layered game sprite for SENSE LEVEL 2. Reference image 1 is the exact approved level-1 botanical DISH SENSOR to evolve. Reference image 2 is the creature's current smooth high-resolution illustration style. Make a clearly more developed two-dish version: exactly TWO matching shallow concave oval leaf satellite dishes side by side, each with the same thick pale ivory-green rim, sage inner bowl and ONE tiny green receiver nub on a short peg inside the cup. Exactly two dishes and two inner nubs in total. Symmetrical left and right, both cups open upward and slightly toward the viewer, same gentle elevated frontal angle and plant material as reference1. A compact sturdier green V-forked stem supports both dishes, converging into ONE short finished central root at bottom middle, ready to attach to the creature's crown. Both full rims remain visible, dishes have a clear small transparent gap between them. This is a modest biological upgrade of the original dish antenna, not a new species. Thicker supporting stem and broader twin-dish silhouette make it visibly stronger than level1. Whole assembly about 1.9 times wider than tall. Render only the complete detached equipment on TRUE clean RGBA transparency. Smooth matte hand-painted pale yellow-green/sage volume, clean dark teal-green continuous outline, very broad restrained shading, small soft highlights. NO insect feelers, NO long curling stems, NO purple buds or purple orbs, NO leaves, sprout, body, character, eyes, face, flowers, metal, wires or futuristic machinery. NO glow, no halo, no hazy translucent aura, no exterior shadow, no black rectangle or painted checkerboard. The background must immediately turn fully transparent outside the crisp outer silhouette. Entire object inside the canvas with a clear generous transparent margin on all sides. No labels or text. No pixel art, jagged edges, dithering, coarse blocks, plastic or photorealism. Actual runtime artwork, not a display board.
